pairs.english: He asked where Fulan had gone to inquire about the wagons, and whether anyone at the freight yard had managed that transfer.

pairs.english: He did not write “I am that child.”

pairs.target: xiě dào zìjǐ rújīn zài tóng jiē chéng , tā yòu tiān le yíjù : ruò háiyǒu biéde rén yě zài zhǎo , qǐng gàosù tāmen yǒurén huí le xìn .
pairs.english: After writing that he now lived in Copperstep, he added: if anyone else was still searching, please tell them someone had answered.
pairs.hanzi: 写到自己如今在铜阶城，他又添了一句：若还有别的人也在找，请告诉他们有人回了信。

pairs.english: Lanxiu came with him to the shed. Only after he checked the AnvilBay address did she go next door to buy breakfast.

pairs.target: tā jīntiān yě yào líkāi , zǒu de shì lìng yìtiáo àn lù , gēn jǐhù yìqǐ huàn yán de rén huíqù .
pairs.english: She was leaving today too, by another bank road, travelling with households who had come to trade for salt.
pairs.hanzi: 她今天也要离开，走的是另一条岸路，跟几户一起换盐的人回去。

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén zhàn zhe chī le bànzhāng bǐng . tǎ wéi xiǎng bǎ xiè zì shuō dé zhèngzhòng xiē , lán xiù què máng zhe cādiào bāo zhǐ shàng de yóu , miǎnde cèng dào tā gāng xiě hǎo de zhàng . "
pairs.english: They stood eating half a flatbread. Tavi wanted to make his thanks solemn, but Lanxiu was busy wiping oil off the wrapper to keep it from her freshly written accounts.
pairs.hanzi:
两个人站着吃了半张饼。塔维想把谢字说得郑重些，岚绣却忙着擦掉包纸上的油，免得蹭到她刚写好的账。
“

pairs.target: dào le xiěxìn . " tā shuō . " xiěgěi nǐ háishì lín yuán ? " "
pairs.english: “Write when you arrive,” she said. “To you or Lin Yuan?”
pairs.hanzi:
到了写信。”她说。
“写给你还是林沅？”
“

pairs.english: “Put ‘care of Lin Yuan’ outside and my name inside. Don't leave me out once it's opened.”
pairs.hanzi: 外头写林沅替转，里头写我。别只有外头有人，拆开没我的事。”

pairs.target: tā xiào zhe dāying . chuángōng zài xiàmiàn cuī rén , tā bǎibǎishǒu , ràng tā zǒu , zìjǐ zhàn zài péng kǒu , jiāng shèngxià de bǐng zhé jìnzhǐ lǐ .
pairs.english: He smiled and promised. The boatman called from below; she waved him on, standing by the shed and folding the remaining bread into paper.
pairs.hanzi: 他笑着答应。船工在下面催人，她摆摆手，让他走，自己站在棚口，将剩下的饼折进纸里。

pairs.target: shàngxíng de chuán bǐ láishí zuò dé mǎn . tǎ wéi bǎ bāo fàngzài jiǎo biān , zuòzài yíduì dài háizi de fūfù duìmiàn .
pairs.english: The upstream boat was fuller than on the way down. Tavi set his bag at his feet, opposite a couple with a child.
pairs.hanzi: 上行的船比来时坐得满。塔维把包放在脚边，坐在一对带孩子的夫妇对面。

pairs.target: nà háizi yìzhí wèn chuán wèishénme bù zǒu , děng chuán zhēnde lí le àn , yòu wèn àn wèishénme wǎnghòu pǎo .
pairs.english: The child kept asking why the boat wasn't moving; once it left shore, he asked why the shore was running backward.
pairs.hanzi: 那孩子一直问船为什么不走，等船真的离了岸，又问岸为什么往后跑。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ pà wò , rěnbúzhù xiào . háizi de fùqīn kàn le tā yìyǎn , bǎ háizi wǎng xī shàng nuó , gěi guòlù de chuángōng ràngchū dìfāng .
pairs.english: Thinking of Pavo, Tavi couldn't help laughing. The father glanced at him and shifted the child onto his knees to make room for a passing boatman.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起帕沃，忍不住笑。孩子的父亲看了他一眼，把孩子往膝上挪，给过路的船工让出地方。

pairs.target: shàngwǔ de fēng yíngmiàn chuī . chuán tiēzhe huǎnliú de ànbiān wǎng shàng , yuǎnchù de shù kàn le hěn jiǔ háishì nà jǐkē .
pairs.english: The morning wind blew into their faces. The boat followed the slower water near the bank; after a long time the same trees still stood ahead.
pairs.hanzi: 上午的风迎面吹。船贴着缓流的岸边往上，远处的树看了很久还是那几棵。

pairs.target: guò yíduàn jí shuǐ qián , chuángōng shōuqǐ chēnggāo , shìyì dàjiā zuò wěn .
pairs.english: Before a stretch of fast water, the crew stowed their poles and signalled everyone to sit tight.
pairs.hanzi: 过一段急水前，船工收起撑篙，示意大家坐稳。

pairs.target: ànshàng yǒurén jiē zhù pāo qù de lǎnshéng , ràoguò mùzhù , lìngwài jǐgè rén yánzhe shí dào wǎngqiánzǒu ,
pairs.english: Someone ashore caught a thrown towline and looped it around a wooden post; others walked along the stone path.

pairs.target: tǎ wéi cè guò shēn , kàn nàxiē rén de jiǎo zěnme cǎi . tāmen búshì yìqí màibù , qiánmiàn de rén xiān zhǎo wěn dìfāng , hòumiàn de rén zài gēnshàng .

就在这时，船头忽然响了一声。
不是撞岸。

pairs.hanzi: 船工举起手，岸上的人立刻停下，后面一个差点踩到前面的脚，骂了一句。

pairs.english: Nobody cheered. The shore crew pulled again; passengers looked down for things that had rolled away.
pairs.hanzi: 没有人欢呼。岸上的人重新拉绳，船上的人低头找刚才滚走的东西。

pairs.hanzi: 孩子终于不问了，靠着母亲的肩，小声说自己不喜欢那个响。

pairs.hanzi: 他慢慢放松，望着水面上那根已经变小的断木。

pairs.hanzi: 一路上看起来安稳的事，原来一直有人在看着。

pairs.english: Tavi bought soup ashore, then returned to the straw mats spread on the boat. With his boots by his head, he slept fitfully.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维上岸买汤，吃完回到船上铺开的草席，靴子放在头边，睡得不算踏实。

pairs.english: They continued upstream the next day, reaching Flat Landing only as darkness approached.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天继续上行，直到天色将暗才回到平码头，

pairs.english: Too late for the last wagon uphill, he used his planned extra day and stayed the night.
pairs.hanzi: 来不及赶上最后一班上城的车，他便照原先多留的日子，住了一夜。

pairs.target: dìsāntiān xiàwǔ , tóng jiē chéng de zhōnglóu chóngxīn lùchū lái .
pairs.english: On the third afternoon, Copperstep's bell tower appeared again.
pairs.hanzi: 第三天下午，铜阶城的钟楼重新露出来。

pairs.target: tā méi zhíjiē huí xuégōng .
pairs.english: He did not go straight to the academy.
pairs.hanzi: 他没直接回学宫。

pairs.target: cóng chēpéng chūlái , tā yán shúlù guǎi xiàng huī ào , bāo dài yā zhe jiān , zǒu dé bǐ chūfā shí màn .
pairs.english: From the wagon shelter he turned along familiar roads toward AshHollow, the bag strap weighing on his shoulder, walking more slowly than when he had left.

pairs.target: mén hái méi tuīkāi , lǐmiàn biàn yǒurén wèn shì shuí . "
pairs.english: Before he opened the door, someone inside asked who it was.
pairs.hanzi:
门还没推开，里面便有人问是谁。
“

pairs.target: wǒ . " tā shuō . wūlǐ xiān jìng le yíxià , suíhòu yǐzi xiǎng le .
pairs.english: “Me,” he said. For a moment the room fell quiet; then a chair scraped.
pairs.hanzi:
我。”他说。
屋里先静了一下，随后椅子响了。
